expectations.text: Recommends the release-with-debug profile for profiling
expectations.evidence: 'For profiling you want release-with-debug, which keeps release optimizations but also keeps debug symbols and skips strip'; uses the repo's existing profile.

expectations.text: Recommends samply (cross-platform/Windows) with flamegraph as alternative
expectations.evidence: 'Use samply here ... works the same on your Windows machine ... cargo flamegraph works too but on Windows its backend goes through ETW/blondie'.

expectations.text: Explains how to read a flamegraph (widest box = most CPU time)
expectations.evidence: X-axis is total CPU time, wider box = more time; hunt the widest box near the top.

expectations.text: Diagnoses likely canvas-tool causes (dirty-rect, per-move clone, frame thread)
expectations.evidence: Section 4 lists per-pixel full-canvas loop, 256MB buffer clone, work on egui frame thread, CPU compositing.

expectations.text: Does not jump straight to a code rewrite without profiling first
expectations.evidence: 'don't apply any of them until the profile actually points there'; rewrite gated on samply output.
